# T-3: Record repair finding references

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Allow repair issue-log entries to store the finding id and repair reference needed for repair correspondence reporting.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Issue-log entries can include a finding id
- Issue-log entries can include commit hash or changed file path references
- Entries missing either side remain valid and are reported as unknown

## Implementation Notes
Keep existing issue-log required fields intact. Add optional normalized finding id and repair reference fields at the issue-log boundary and avoid project-specific finding id formats.

## Test Strategy
Issue-log command tests for entries with full references, partial references, and no references.
